sentences.l2: 第一次在婆家操办家宴，我格外谨慎。
sentences.l1: Hosting a family banquet at my in-laws' home for the first time, I was especially cautious.

sentences.l2: 婆婆说，圆桌的座次虽不成文，却自有分寸：公公坐正对门口的主位，婆婆在他左侧，方便招呼客人；我和丈夫坐在靠近厨房的位置，便于添汤上菜。
sentences.l1: My mother-in-law said that although the seating order at a round table is unwritten, it has its own sense of proportion: my father-in-law sits in the main seat directly facing the door, my mother-in-law is on his left, so she can look after the guests; my husband and I sit near the kitchen, convenient for adding soup and serving dishes.

sentences.l2: 开席前，长辈不动筷，晚辈便不能先吃；若有客人迟到，也要先向长辈说明，再轻声招呼，免得场面尴尬。
sentences.l1: Before the meal begins, if the elders do not pick up their chopsticks, the younger ones cannot eat first; if a guest arrives late, one should also first explain to the elders, and then greet the guest quietly, to avoid an awkward scene.

sentences.l2: 敬酒时，我先双手举杯，杯沿略低于长辈的杯口，再说几句客套话，感谢他们平日照顾。
sentences.l1: When toasting, I first raise my glass with both hands, with the rim slightly lower than the rim of the elders' glasses, and then say a few polite words, thanking them for looking after me in daily life.

sentences.l2: 丈夫提醒我，给婆婆敬酒时不可只劝她喝，也要替她挡一些酒，免得她为难。
sentences.l1: My husband reminded me that when toasting my mother-in-law, I must not only urge her to drink, but also drink some on her behalf, so she is not put in a difficult position.

sentences.l2: 这些规矩看似繁琐，其实都在表达尊重与体贴。
sentences.l1: These rules seem tedious, but in fact they all express respect and consideration.

sentences.l2: 我照此行事，心里才踏实。
sentences.l1: Only when I act accordingly do I feel at ease.
